confidence_notes: Medium overall. Beer, coffee and restaurant anchors triangulate several 2026 aggregator and Numbeo figures, but the sources mix dates, currencies and cities (Marmaris, Alanya, Istanbul, national averages). Cocktail and wine rest on Bar Street and Alanya guides plus a beer-relative basis, since no Marmaris bar menus were found. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not checked against live listings or booking pages. The FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview page; I did not open the RBA table, and no 19 November observation was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Marmaris is a Muğla-province Aegean resort. Turkey is grouped in Western Asia, so it is placed under Middle East, with prices benchmarked to Mediterranean resort markets. Restaurant and coffee anchors draw on Marmaris-specific aggregator figures where available, Numbeo USD estimates, and Alanya and Istanbul guides, adjusted for resort pricing and Turkish inflation. Cocktail and wine use Alanya and Bar Street guides and a ratio to the beer anchor. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Aegean resort rates in July.
